blocks.en: Understand the regulatory requirements for pharmaceutical packaging waste (EU Packaging Waste Directive, US state-level regulations) and reverse logistics solutions

blocks.en: Understand the direct and indirect costs of distribution failures (temperature excursions/cold chain breaks) and the design elements of a business continuity plan (BCP)

blocks.en: Four Cost Topics Covered in This Section

blocks.en: Inventory management (7.1): cost impact of static stockpiling vs. dynamic rotation

blocks.zh: 關鍵視角：成本與患者安全的平衡
blocks.en: Key Perspective: Balancing Cost and Patient Safety

blocks.zh: TR46 強調：省成本不能以犧牲產品品質為代價。每項成本優化決策都必須通過「是否影響患者可及性和產品完整性」的篩選。
blocks.en: TR46 stresses that cost savings must never come at the expense of product quality. Every cost optimization decision must pass the screen of whether it affects patient access or product integrity.

blocks.zh: 7.1 庫存管理 — 解析
blocks.en: 7.1 Inventory Management - Analysis

blocks.zh: FIFO vs. FEFO：藥品應選哪一個？
blocks.en: FIFO vs. FEFO: Which Should Pharmaceuticals Use?

blocks.zh: FIFO（First In First Out，先進先出）：按入庫時間順序出庫，適用於保質期均一的商品（如一般食品）。
blocks.en: FIFO (First In First Out): products are issued in the order they were received; suitable for goods with uniform shelf life (such as ordinary foods).

blocks.zh: FEFO（First Expired First Out，先效期先出）：按最早到期日順序出庫，無論入庫時間先後。
blocks.en: FEFO (First Expired First Out): products are issued in order of earliest expiry date, regardless of when they were received.

blocks.zh: 藥品為什麼必須用 FEFO？同一批次到貨的藥品，剩餘效期可能因補貨批次不同而有差異。FEFO 確保近效期產品優先出庫，最大限度減少過期浪費。GDP 要求倉儲流程採用 FEFO 原則（TR46 Section 7.1.1）。
blocks.en: Why must pharmaceuticals use FEFO? Product delivered in the same shipment may have different remaining shelf life because of different replenishment batches. FEFO ensures that near-expiry product is issued first, minimizing losses from expiry. GDP requires warehousing processes to apply the FEFO principle (TR46 Section 7.1.1).

blocks.zh: 囤積（Stockpiling）的風險：COVID-19 教訓
blocks.en: Risks of Stockpiling: Lessons from COVID-19

blocks.zh: COVID-19 疫情初期，各國政府和醫院大量囤積口罩、消毒用品及部分藥品（如碘化鉀片）。靜態囤積（Static Stockpiling）的後果：
blocks.en: In the early stage of the COVID-19 pandemic, governments and hospitals stockpiled large quantities of masks, disinfectants and some medicines (such as potassium iodide tablets). The consequences of static stockpiling:

blocks.zh: 效期浪費：囤積品若未與正常庫存輪換，大量到期銷毀
blocks.en: Expiry waste: stockpiled items that are not rotated with normal stock expire in large quantities and are destroyed

blocks.zh: 資金凍結：採購成本全額損失，無殘值回收
blocks.en: Capital tied up: the full purchase cost is lost, with no residual value recovered

blocks.zh: 供應鏈扭曲：搶購造成正常配送斷鏈，患者無法取得所需藥品
blocks.en: Supply chain distortion: panic buying disrupts normal distribution, leaving patients unable to obtain the medicines they need

blocks.zh: 環境負擔：大批次銷毀帶來額外廢棄物處理成本
blocks.en: Environmental burden: destruction of large quantities creates additional waste treatment costs

blocks.zh: 動態輪換（Dynamic Stockpiling / FEFO）則可將緩衝庫存融入日常供應流，有效避免上述問題。
blocks.en: Dynamic stockpiling (FEFO rotation) integrates buffer stock into the routine supply flow and effectively avoids these problems.

blocks.zh: 安全庫存量（Safety Stock）計算思考
blocks.en: Thinking About Safety Stock Calculation

blocks.zh: 基本公式：
blocks.en: Basic formula:

blocks.zh: Safety Stock = Z × σ(Lead Time) × 日均消耗量
blocks.en: Safety Stock = Z × σ(Lead Time) × average daily consumption

blocks.zh: 其中 Z 為安全係數（服務水準對應的標準差倍數，如 95% 服務水準 → Z = 1.65）。
blocks.en: Here Z is the safety factor (the number of standard deviations corresponding to the service level; for example, a 95% service level gives Z = 1.65).

blocks.zh: 最後一哩特別考量：最後一哩配送因天氣、交通、海關等變數，Lead Time 波動比一般批發配送更大。因此安全係數需適度提高，並定期以歷史配送資料重新校正。
blocks.en: Special consideration for the last mile: because of weather, traffic, customs and other variables, lead time varies more in last mile delivery than in ordinary wholesale distribution. The safety factor should therefore be raised appropriately and recalibrated periodically using historical delivery data.

blocks.zh: 思考題：若某冷藏藥品平均日銷量 50 單位，Lead Time 標準差 2 天，目標服務水準 98%（Z≈2.05），安全庫存應設多少？
blocks.en: Exercise: A refrigerated medicine has average daily sales of 50 units, a lead time standard deviation of 2 days and a target service level of 98% (Z ≈ 2.05). What safety stock should be set?

blocks.zh: 7.2 倉儲溫控成本 — 深度解析
blocks.en: 7.2 Cost of Temperature-Controlled Storage - In-Depth Analysis

blocks.zh: 台灣 GMP/GDP 倉儲要求對照
blocks.en: Comparison of Taiwan GMP/GDP Warehousing Requirements

blocks.zh: 台灣藥品倉儲需符合 GMP（衛福部食藥署）及 GDP 要求，主要包括：
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical warehousing in Taiwan must comply with GMP and GDP requirements (Taiwan FDA, Ministry of Health and Welfare), mainly including:

blocks.zh: 溫濕度持續監控（須保存至少效期後一年的記錄）
blocks.en: Continuous temperature and humidity monitoring (records must be kept for at least one year after expiry)

blocks.zh: 溫度分佈測試（每 3 年或設備變更後重新執行）
blocks.en: Temperature mapping (repeated every 3 years or after equipment changes)

blocks.zh: 防蟲防鼠措施（定期蟲害防治合約）
blocks.en: Pest control measures (regular pest control contract)

blocks.zh: 隔離區設置：合格品 / 不合格品 / 退貨品 / 待驗品需分區或加鎖
blocks.en: Segregated areas: released / rejected / returned / quarantined goods must be kept in separate areas or under lock

blocks.zh: 緊急用備用電源（停電後的持溫時間需依產品要求設計）
blocks.en: Emergency backup power (the temperature holding time after a power outage must be designed according to product requirements)

blocks.zh: 台灣對比歐盟 GDP：歐盟要求更嚴格的 QRM（品質風險管理）文件，台灣目前主要依藥廠 SOP 執行，尚無統一 GDP 單一法規文件。
blocks.en: Taiwan vs. EU GDP: the EU requires more rigorous QRM (quality risk management) documentation, whereas Taiwan currently relies mainly on company SOPs and has no single unified GDP regulatory document.

blocks.zh: 7.3 包裝廢棄物與逆向物流 — 解析
blocks.en: 7.3 Packaging Waste and Reverse Logistics - Analysis

blocks.zh: 藥品回收計畫比較
blocks.en: Comparison of Medicine Take-Back Programs

blocks.zh: 美國 DEA 授權回收（Drug Take-Back）：依 2010 年 Secure and Responsible Drug Disposal Act，DEA 授權藥局、醫院、執法機關設置回收點，用於管制藥品及一般處方藥的安全銷毀，避免環境污染及藥物濫用。
blocks.en: US DEA-authorized take-back (Drug Take-Back): under the 2010 Secure and Responsible Drug Disposal Act, the DEA authorizes pharmacies, hospitals and law enforcement agencies to set up collection sites for the safe destruction of controlled substances and ordinary prescription drugs, preventing environmental contamination and drug abuse.

blocks.zh: 台灣藥局回收機制：衛福部食藥署推動「廢棄藥品回收」，藥局作為回收點，收集後由各縣市環保局或合法處理業者焚化銷毀。尚無統一全國性帶回計畫，各地執行方式不一。
blocks.en: Taiwan pharmacy take-back mechanism: the Taiwan FDA promotes "waste medicine collection", with pharmacies serving as collection points; the collected medicines are incinerated by municipal environmental protection bureaus or licensed waste handlers. There is no unified national take-back program, and implementation differs from place to place.

blocks.zh: 逆向物流成本：為何比正向貴 1.5–3 倍？
blocks.en: Reverse Logistics Cost: Why 1.5-3 Times More Expensive Than Forward Logistics?

blocks.zh: 逆向物流（Reverse Logistics）的成本結構遠比正向配送複雜：
blocks.en: The cost structure of reverse logistics is far more complex than that of forward distribution:

blocks.zh: 隔離儲存：回收品需獨立儲存區，避免與合格品混淆
blocks.en: Segregated storage: returned goods need a separate storage area to avoid confusion with released product

blocks.zh: 品質評估：每批回收需檢查完整性、溫控記錄、有效期
blocks.en: Quality assessment: each returned batch must be checked for integrity, temperature control records and expiry date

blocks.zh: 文件記錄：GMP/GDP 要求完整追蹤，包括回收原因、數量、處置方式
blocks.en: Documentation: GMP/GDP require full traceability, including the reason for return, quantity and method of disposition

blocks.zh: 低規模效益：回收量少且不穩定，無法享有正向配送的規模優勢
blocks.en: Low economies of scale: return volumes are small and irregular, so the scale advantages of forward distribution are lost

blocks.zh: 拆解人力：冷鏈包材（PCM 冰袋、VIP 隔熱板）需人工分類才能回收
blocks.en: Disassembly labor: cold chain packaging materials (PCM ice packs, VIP insulation panels) must be sorted by hand before they can be recycled

blocks.zh: PCM 冰袋回收 vs. 一次性銷毀：永續性辯證
blocks.en: PCM Ice Pack Recovery vs. Single-Use Disposal: The Sustainability Debate

blocks.zh: 製造商回收再用方案：
blocks.en: Manufacturer take-back and reuse program:

blocks.zh: 優點：降低每次使用成本、減少材料廢棄
blocks.en: Advantages: lower cost per use and less material waste

blocks.zh: 挑戰：需建立回收物流網絡、清潔 SOP、再驗證程序；回收率需達 60–70% 以上才划算
blocks.en: Challenges: requires a return logistics network, cleaning SOPs and requalification procedures; the return rate must reach 60-70% or more to be cost-effective

blocks.zh: 一次性銷毀方案：
blocks.en: Single-use disposal program:

blocks.zh: 優點：操作簡單、無回收追蹤成本、避免交叉污染風險
blocks.en: Advantages: simple to operate, no return tracking costs, no risk of cross-contamination

blocks.zh: 缺點：大量 EPS/PCM 廢棄物；不符合 EU Green Deal 精神；長期成本高
blocks.en: Disadvantages: large quantities of EPS/PCM waste; not in keeping with the spirit of the EU Green Deal; high long-term cost

blocks.zh: 結論：高價值、高使用頻率的配送路線（如固定航線的生物製劑）更適合回收再用；低頻次、長途最後一哩配送則一次性方案更具現實性。
blocks.en: Conclusion: high-value, high-frequency distribution lanes (such as biologics on fixed air routes) are better suited to reuse; for low-frequency, long-distance last mile deliveries, single-use solutions are more practical.

blocks.zh: 7.4 最低成本溫控方案 — 決策工具
blocks.en: 7.4 Lowest-Cost Temperature Control Solutions - Decision Tool

blocks.zh: 溫控包裝全生命週期總擁有成本（TCO）公式
blocks.en: Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Formula for the Whole Life Cycle of Temperature-Controlled Packaging

blocks.zh:
TCO = 採購成本（Purchase Cost）
    + 驗證成本（Qualification: IQ/OQ/PQ）
    + 操作成本（充電 PCM / 充填冰袋 / 人工預冷）
    + 廢棄成本（Disposal: 銷毀費用 + 環保稅）
    - 回收殘值（Salvage Value: 若回收再用）

補充：
  運費 = 重量 × 運費率（被動方案因重量大，運費可能高於包材本身）
  總配送成本 = TCO（包材）+ 運費 + 失敗成本概率 × 損失金額
blocks.en:
TCO = Purchase Cost
    + Qualification Cost (IQ/OQ/PQ)
    + Operating Cost (charging PCM / filling ice packs / manual pre-conditioning)
    + Disposal Cost (destruction fees + environmental tax)
    - Salvage Value (if returned and reused)

In addition:
  Freight = weight × freight rate (for passive solutions, freight may exceed the cost of the packaging itself because of their weight)
  Total distribution cost = TCO (packaging) + freight + probability of failure × loss amount

blocks.zh: 實務上，被動式 VIP+PCM 方案雖採購成本高，但因體積小、重量輕，運費節省往往能覆蓋價差，反而比傳統 EPS+水冰盒更具總成本優勢。
blocks.en: In practice, although a passive VIP+PCM solution has a higher purchase cost, its small volume and low weight mean that freight savings often cover the price difference, giving it a better total cost than a traditional EPS + water ice pack box.

blocks.zh: 被動 vs. 主動：關鍵選擇因素
blocks.en: Passive vs. Active: Key Selection Factors

blocks.zh: 被動（Passive）：低操作複雜性、無電力依賴；但保護時間有限，超過設計窗口即失效。驗證需針對最惡劣溫度情境（Summer/Winter Profile）。
blocks.en: Passive: low operational complexity and no dependence on electric power, but protection time is limited and the system fails once the design window is exceeded. Qualification must address the worst-case temperature scenarios (summer/winter profiles).

blocks.zh: 主動（Active）：持續維持溫度、適合長途；但依賴電力（需備用電源計畫）、設備重、維護複雜。
blocks.en: Active: maintains temperature continuously and suits long distances, but depends on electric power (a backup power plan is needed), is heavy and is complex to maintain.

blocks.zh: 黃金法則：包材性能窗口必須覆蓋「最長預期運輸時間 + 緩衝時間（通常 +12h 或 +25%）」。
blocks.en: Golden rule: the performance window of the packaging must cover the longest expected transit time plus a buffer (typically +12 h or +25%).

blocks.zh: 7.5 失敗成本與業務持續計畫 — 解析
blocks.en: 7.5 Cost of Failure and Business Continuity Planning - Analysis

blocks.zh: 業務持續計畫（BCP）三要素框架
blocks.en: Three-Element BCP Framework

blocks.zh: 預防（Prevent） — 事前消除風險來源
blocks.en: Prevent - eliminate sources of risk in advance

blocks.zh: 偵測（Detect） — 即時監控快速發現偏差
blocks.en: Detect - rapidly identify deviations through real-time monitoring

blocks.zh: 回應（Respond） — 標準化應急程序最小化損失
blocks.en: Respond - minimize losses through standardized emergency procedures

blocks.zh: BCP 文件設計思考題
blocks.en: BCP Document Design Exercise

blocks.zh: 假設你是一家台灣生技公司的 QA 主管，負責設計最後一哩配送的 BCP。請思考：
blocks.en: Suppose you are the QA manager of a Taiwanese biotech company responsible for designing the BCP for last mile delivery. Consider the following:

blocks.zh: 台灣颱風季（7–9 月）對冷鏈最後一哩的最大風險是什麼？（提示：停電、道路中斷、機場關閉）
blocks.en: What is the greatest risk to last mile cold chain during Taiwan's typhoon season (July-September)? (Hint: power outages, road closures, airport shutdowns)

blocks.zh: 你的 BCP 需要定義哪些「觸發點」（Trigger Points）來啟動應急程序？（溫度偏差門檻？停電持續時間？）
blocks.en: What trigger points does your BCP need to define to activate emergency procedures? (Temperature excursion threshold? Duration of power outage?)

blocks.zh: 演練頻率應設為多少？（建議：每年至少一次桌上演練 + 每三年一次實際演習）
blocks.en: How often should drills be held? (Recommendation: at least one tabletop exercise per year + one actual drill every three years)

blocks.zh: 8.0 TR46 核心信息結構化回顧
blocks.en: 8.0 Structured Review of TR46 Core Messages

blocks.zh: TR46 最後一哩 GDP：5 個關鍵控制點
blocks.en: TR46 Last Mile GDP: 5 Key Control Points

blocks.zh: 產品知識與穩定性預算（Sections 2–3）：在設計配送方案前，必須確認產品的溫度敏感性、效期穩定性預算（Stability Budget），並據此選擇合適的包材和運輸方式。
blocks.en: Product knowledge and stability budget (Sections 2-3): before designing a distribution solution, confirm the product's temperature sensitivity and shelf-life stability budget, and select suitable packaging and transport modes accordingly.

blocks.zh: 包裝與設備驗證（Section 4）：被動/主動溫控方案需通過基於最惡劣條件的 IQ/OQ/PQ 驗證，並定期複驗。資格認證記錄是法規查核的關鍵文件。
blocks.en: Packaging and equipment qualification (Section 4): passive/active temperature-controlled solutions must pass IQ/OQ/PQ based on worst-case conditions and be requalified periodically. Qualification records are key documents in regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: 監控、偏差管理與追蹤（Sections 5–6）：溫度監控器選型、資料完整性（ALCOA+）、偏差調查流程（根本原因分析 + CAPA）、及供應鏈各環節的移交文件是維持合規的核心。
blocks.en: Monitoring, deviation management and traceability (Sections 5-6): monitor selection, data integrity (ALCOA+), the deviation investigation process (root cause analysis + CAPA) and handoff documentation at every link of the supply chain are the core of maintaining compliance.

blocks.zh: 教育訓練與利益相關方協作（Section 6.8–6.10）：從製造商到患者的完整教育矩陣，確保每個移交點（Handoff Point）的人員都了解自身責任，是最後一哩溫鏈完整性的最後防線。
blocks.en: Training and stakeholder collaboration (Sections 6.8-6.10): a complete training matrix from manufacturer to patient ensures that personnel at every handoff point understand their own responsibilities; this is the last line of defense for cold chain integrity in the last mile.

blocks.zh: 成本管理與永續性（Section 7）：FEFO 庫存輪換、TCO 導向的包材決策、EPR 法規合規、BCP 設計——成本優化必須在不損害產品品質的前提下進行。
blocks.en: Cost management and sustainability (Section 7): FEFO stock rotation, TCO-based packaging decisions, EPR regulatory compliance and BCP design; cost optimization must be carried out without compromising product quality.

blocks.zh: TR46 的核心訊息（一句話）
blocks.en: The Core Message of TR46 in One Sentence

blocks.zh: 最後一哩的成功，不依靠單一環節的完美執行，而依靠整條供應鏈的協同合作——從製造商、批發商、物流服務提供者、藥師到患者，每個角色都是溫鏈的守護者。
blocks.en: Success in the last mile does not depend on the perfect execution of any single link, but on collaboration across the entire supply chain: from manufacturers, wholesalers and logistics service providers to pharmacists and patients, every role is a guardian of the cold chain.

blocks.zh: TR46 與其他 PDA TR 的關係
blocks.en: Relationship of TR46 to Other PDA TRs

blocks.zh: PDA TR39（溫控運輸）：TR46 引用 TR39 作為溫控藥品運輸的基礎指引；TR46 聚焦最後一哩的特殊挑戰
blocks.en: PDA TR39 (temperature-controlled transport): TR46 cites TR39 as the foundational guidance for transporting temperature-controlled medicines; TR46 focuses on the specific challenges of the last mile

blocks.zh: PDA TR52（GDP）：TR46 為 TR52 GDP 原則在最後一哩的具體應用
blocks.en: PDA TR52 (GDP): TR46 is the application of the TR52 GDP principles to the last mile

blocks.zh: PDA TR58（風險管理）：TR46 的風險評估框架參照 TR58，需結合 ICH Q9(R1)
blocks.en: PDA TR58 (risk management): the TR46 risk assessment framework refers to TR58 and should be combined with ICH Q9(R1)

blocks.zh: PDA TR64/TR72（主動/被動系統驗證）：TR46 Section 4 的包材驗證直接引用這兩份 TR 的方法論
blocks.en: PDA TR64/TR72 (active/passive system qualification): the packaging qualification in TR46 Section 4 directly adopts the methodology of these two TRs

blocks.zh: 9.0 參考文獻導覽
blocks.en: 9.0 Guide to the References

blocks.zh: TR46 考試高頻引用文件
